method: Seeded draw (6172) of one translated page from each of 28 distractor books in pool T (Latin/German/French/Italian, 2 spares per language); 8 skipped as non-substantive or redundant (anagram poem, title page, verse, biography fragment, legal/shooting-match duplicates). OCR and translation read in full (read-from-text, AI reader). form=orig: query in the page language with its own period spellings, not copied verbatim; form=en: English query carrying a Latin/German/French term from the page. Relevant set = that one page.
